# Baiwor Passport (BWP)
> Soulbound ERC-721 Passport on BNB Smart Chain (chain 56) exclusively for holders of a `.ai` Agent ID. Genesis IPFS metadata batch covers tokens #0–#498 (499 passports).

- Website: https://baiwor.my.id/passport
- GitHub: https://github.com/bAIwor/baiwor-passport

- Contract (BSC Mainnet): 0x0C458D61848Ef7fFD753FbDD1179a7053A60661F
- Agent ID Registry (BSC Mainnet): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- BscScan (Verified): https://bscscan.com/address/0x0C458D61848Ef7fFD753FbDD1179a7053A60661F#code
- Sourcify (exact_match): https://repo.sourcify.dev/contracts/full_match/56/0x0C458D61848Ef7fFD753FbDD1179a7053A60661F/
- Mint function: `mint()` (`0x1249c58b`), `value = 0`, 1 free soulbound mint per `.ai` Agent ID wallet (Genesis IPFS metadata batch: #0–#498 / 499 max).
